blocks.content: When changes are made on GitHub, you bring them to your machine with:

remote: Enumerating objects: 5, done. remote: Total 5 (delta 1), reused 0 (delta 0) Unpacking objects: 100% (5/5), done. From https://github.com/you/myproject 4f3a1b2..9c2f4a1  main -> origin/main Updating 4f3a1b2..9c2f4a1 Fast-forward index.html | 8 ++++++-- 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
git pull fetches the changes from GitHub and merges them into your current branch. Your local repository is now in sync.
Pull before you start working. If someone else has pushed since you last synced, you want their changes before you add your own.
